texts: The maintenance agreement says our company is the seller and Fablemesh Gauge Ltd is the buyer and customer. Umberwisp Milling Cooperative only supplies goods to us and has never been our customer. The folder tab is turquoise.

Tamarisk Chisel Society bought a mapping service from our company during an earlier engagement, making it our client then. The account is now closed; it is not our customer today. The drawer liner is cream.
Bracken Loomworks PLC has never been our customer. Our only dealings with that company are as its buyer of packing supplies. The hinge cover is matte.

Hollowfen Beacon Association is identified as an incorporated organization in a catalogue. The catalogue establishes nothing about whether it has ever bought from our company. The binding thread is white.
The words 'customer', 'supplier' and 'buyer' are headings for roles; the sample does not supply any organization's name. The chart background is ivory.
In the workshop notes, splice means a join between pieces. The organization legally registered as splice is a customer of our company. The border line is dotted.
苍梭检衡合作社是向本公司购买校验服务的买方，合同将其列为客户；萤垣织材厂仅向我们售货，合同明确说它从未是我们的客户。封面底色为浅蓝色。
我们曾为汐砧工模社完成一笔付费检测，该组织当时是我们的客户；这段业务现已结束，它目前不再是我们的客户。资料袋采用横向开口。
琥籽筛具有限公司与本公司只存在供货关系，它向我们卖材料，且从未向我们购买服务，因此从来不是我们的客户。托盘表面为磨砂质地。
展览简介把雾稞仪表联盟介绍为一家正式组织，正文没有说明它与本公司之间是否存在过任何客户关系。目录采用单栏排版。
“客户机构”指角色类别，“采购方”也只是关系名称；本段没有指定哪一家组织。附页使用圆角边框。
“捻线”是一家组织登记使用的完整名称，该组织正向本公司购买维护服务，是我们的客户；工艺段落另说“捻线”可以把纤维合成细绳。页面留有宽边距。
